review_scope: Fresh source-only review of hosted guest Scrape acceptance and existing native UI/harness contracts; no hosted run or product edits.

evidence: tests/browser/scrape-guest-native-acceptance.mjs:289 navigates the sole owned page to chrome://settings/.
tests/browser/scrape-guest-native-acceptance.mjs:314 calls reloadExtension while page is still chrome://settings/.
tests/browser/native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs:404 reopens by clicking page.locator('#open-panel'), a control supplied only by the owned localhost root fixture.
findings.effect: The replacement panel cannot be opened, so the extension_reload stage times out and the overall report becomes unverified even if prior capture observations succeeded.
findings.repair: Navigate the owned page back to its localhost root fixture before reloadExtension; after reload, navigate to an owned content page, select Scrape with trusted input, and assert the intended empty state there.

evidence: tests/browser/scrape-guest-native-acceptance.mjs:315-325 checks only that the replacement panel's Scrape view is ready and empty, then marks T20 passed.
The T20 inventory criterion is No current capture empty state; the replacement panel may default to Chat, and an empty restricted-page state does not establish normal-page navigation/reload behavior.
findings.effect: After fixing the opener, T20 could be promoted on weak evidence or fail because the Scrape tab was never selected.
findings.repair: Select Scrape explicitly in the replacement panel and verify title, enabled Capture, empty result and cleared prior content on an owned normal page before marking T20 passed.

positive_source_observations: Workflow guest-scrape requires a selected release run and rejects development and Store CRX modes.
Wrapper verifies published receipt source SHA, ZIP hashes, unpacked tree hash and version; native harness rechecks tree and manifest.
Isolated Chrome profile and trusted UI driver are reused; guest account and auth storage are checked before capture.
Fixture's late text starts absent and appears only after scroll; fast and deep assertions distinguish their outcomes.
Result tab and restricted-page checks retain partial status for unexercised content and natural recovery actions.
